AltergressiveV2 README
Run with these tweaks

##Main Settings##
!preset custom
!teamsize 8
!bset assistdronesbuildpowermultiplier 1
!bset assistdronesenabled enabled
!bset commanderbuildersbuildpower 1000
!bset commanderbuildersenabled enabled
!bset commanderbuildersrange 2000
!bset disablemapdamage 1
!bset experimentalextraunits 1
!bset experimentallegionfaction 1
!bset experimentalshields absorbeverything
!bset maxunits 1000
!bset scavunitsforplayers 1
!bset forceallunits 1
!bset evocom 1
!bset evocomlevelupmultiplier 0.5
$rename PvE [Modded BarBs] Extra+Scav+Legion Settings
$welcome-message Altergressive AI is based on (now deprecated) Felnious AI found here: (https://github.com/Kazuhira95/BARbots) Forked from: (https://github.com/Felnious/Skirmish)


##Tweakdefs##
T3 Geo  Wall  Nanos  Spy Satellite  = tweakdefs1    (I added Spy Satellite, Original Author: https://discord.com/channels/549281623154229250/1375226452106150128)
             T4 Defense             = tweakdefs2    (I added Epic Bastion in here, edited some of the things in T4 Defense, OG Author: https://discord.com/channels/549281623154229250/1394343181931253790)
       Arm Leg LVL 10 Shield        = tweakdefs3    (Cannot find OG Author)
            Epic Shields            = tweakdefs4    (Pulled from website and added in missing factions: https://relicus.github.io/pyrem-bar-nuttyconfigurator/)
       Epic Bulwark For Com         = tweakdefs5    (As it says Epic Bulwark for high level Cortex Commander)
               T4 ECO               = tweakdefs6    (Pulled from website: https://relicus.github.io/pyrem-bar-nuttyconfigurator/)
            DefensiveSuper          = tweakdefs7    (Pulled from website and some values were edited: https://relicus.github.io/pyrem-bar-nuttyconfigurator/)
           RepairCarriers           = tweakdefs8    (I removed the reclaim carriers as they don't work yet, OG Author: https://discord.com/channels/549281623154229250/1474894094110163154)
           
!bset tweakdefs1 -
!bset tweakdefs2 
!bset tweakdefs3 
!bset tweakdefs4 

!bset tweakdefs5 
!bset tweakdefs6 
!bset tweakdefs7 
!bset tweakdefs8 -
